subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using the parts of sentences from each column of the table below:
stimulus: Independence went the war. No nation took place to the battlefield to save the country. Our war of liberation be it without struggle. People of all walks of life joined in 1971. They can achieve the birthright of a nation
guide_solution: (a) Independence is the birthright of a nation. (b) No nation can achieve it without struggle. (c) Our war of liberation took place in 1971. (d) People of all walks of life joined the war. (e) They went to the battlefield to save the country.
